description: This file defines the RouteRunner class within the Slim Framework. It implements the RequestHandlerInterface to handle HTTP requests by resolving routes, performing routing middleware if necessary, and dispatching to matched routes.

classes.name: RouteRunner
classes.description: Handles routing logic by resolving routes and executing the appropriate route for a given request.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteRunner with route resolver, parser, and optional route collector proxy.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an incoming server request, performing routing if necessary, and executes the matched route.
